name: Atlassian Design System · Button

title.zh: Atlassian Design System · 按 Atlassian 规范

description.zh: 最后开 Button。现场预览和 @atlaskit/button 源码都在。 Atlassian Design System 文档站，提供基础、组件与 Figma 资源。站点许可限定用于与 Atlassian 产品互通的插件；npm 包 @atlaskit/button 标 Apache-2.0。文档公开可读。
description.en: Atlassian Design System 文档站，提供基础、组件与 Figma 资源。站点许可限定用于与 Atlassian 产品互通的插件；npm 包 @atlaskit/button 标 Apache-2.0。文档公开可读。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Atlassian Design System (https://atlassian.design/).
Technology stack: react, javascript, typescript, css.
Component specification: 最后开 Button。现场预览和 @atlaskit/button 源码都在。

Visual details from source observation: 首页截图超时，我们改看 Get started：Design、Develop、Content design 三张卡。Components 目录 Forms and inputs 下列 Button、Calendar、Checkbox。点开 Button：Default button 预览和 import Button from '@atlaskit/button/default/button'。适合做 Atlassian 插件的人。文档免费；ADS 许可限制用途，别把整站当成可任意商用的 MIT 套件。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).

offers.scope: Documentation is public; ADS license limits use to Atlassian add-ons; @atlaskit packages are Apache-2.0
